name: Camp Winadu
description_short: Boys' sleepaway camp in the Berkshire Mountains near Pittsfield, Massachusetts. Offers a full summer season and a 5-week option for new younger campers, with team and individual sports, ice hockey, waterfront, outdoor adventure, and arts.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Dates & Rates | Camp Winadu - Boys Summer Camp, Berkshire Mountains, Pittsfield, Massachusetts

warnings: The 2027 prices depend on when you enroll: before September 15 it's $16,600 (full season) and $13,500 (5-week). After that it's $16,950 and $13,800. Today is 2026-10-13, so I recorded the after-September-15 prices. The page doesn't give a year for the deadline; I'm assuming it's September 15, 2026.
The page also shows dates for 2026 and dates and rates for 2024. In the 2024 table, the 5-week rate after the deadline ($12,300) is lower than the early rate ($12,600), which looks like a typo.
In the 2026 section, Sibling Rookie Day is listed as 'Saturday, July 17', but July 17, 2026 is a Friday.
The 2027 end date for the 5-week session isn't given. In 2024 it ended Monday, July 28.
Bus transportation, optional golf and ice hockey, and canteen and trip fees for older campers all cost extra on top of tuition.
This is a boys-only camp. A sister girls' camp is mentioned.
